name: bettershield
description: Development tooling for the BetterShield plugin. The plugin itself ships no Node runtime code.

scripts.build: wp-scripts build assets/js/setup.js assets/js/widget.js assets/js/profile.js assets/js/deactivate.js assets/js/account-block.js next=./assets/js/next/index.js --output-path=assets/build && node bin/postbuild.js
scripts.start: wp-scripts start assets/js/setup.js assets/js/widget.js assets/js/profile.js assets/js/deactivate.js assets/js/account-block.js next=./assets/js/next/index.js --output-path=assets/build
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run deps && npm run i18n && npm run plugin-zip
scripts.test:php:multisite: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/bettershield bash -c "WP_MULTISITE=1 vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit-multisite.xml.dist"
